```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)

gss <- read_dta("gss7224_r3a.dta") %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

table(gss$year)
```
```{r}
gss_sub <- gss |> filter(year %in% c(2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2021, 2022, 2024))

table(gss_sub$year, gss_sub$happy, useNA = "ifany")
table(gss_sub$year, gss_sub$partyid, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
gss_sub |>
  summarise(across(c(age, sex, race, educ, marital, realinc, region),
                   ~ mean(is.na(.x))))
```
```{r}
gss_chk <- gss_sub |>
  filter(partyid %in% 0:6, happy %in% 1:3) |>
  mutate(
    party3 = case_when(partyid <= 2 ~ "Dem",
                       partyid == 3 ~ "Ind",
                       TRUE ~ "Rep"),
    inc_miss = is.na(realinc)
  )

# 各年缺失率
gss_chk |> group_by(year) |> summarise(miss = mean(inc_miss))

# 各年 × 政黨缺失率
gss_chk |> group_by(year, party3) |> summarise(miss = mean(inc_miss), .groups = "drop")

# 缺失者與非缺失者的 very happy 比例
gss_chk |> group_by(inc_miss) |> summarise(very_happy = mean(happy == 1))
```
```{r}
gss_sub |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    wtssps_ok    = mean(!is.na(wtssps)),
    wtssnrps_ok  = mean(!is.na(wtssnrps)),
    wtssall_ok   = mean(!is.na(wtssall)),
    wtssps_mean  = mean(wtssps, na.rm = TRUE),
    wtssnrps_mean = mean(wtssnrps, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
```{r}
gss_sub |>
  summarise(
    cor_w   = cor(wtssps, wtssnrps, use = "complete.obs"),
    n_diff  = sum(abs(wtssps - wtssnrps) > 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
gss_sub |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    cor_w  = cor(wtssps, wtssnrps, use = "complete.obs"),
    pct_diff = mean(abs(wtssps - wtssnrps) > 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
```{r}
gss_sub |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(vpsu_ok = mean(!is.na(vpsu)), vstrat_ok = mean(!is.na(vstrat)))
```

```{r}
gss_sub |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(n_strata = n_distinct(vstrat),
            n_psu    = n_distinct(vpsu),
            n_cells  = n_distinct(paste(vstrat, vpsu)))
```
